backup.restore_point: PLACEHOLDER: stamp with fill-restore-point.mjs at apply time
backup.production_rule: Who is staying follows the guest record (Lloyd 2026-11-20, D-390, contract docs/s129/CONTRACT-staying.md SQL lane). Replaces ONE live body in place behind an md5 guard (CR stripped, 55000 when the live body is neither the original nor this release): public.staff_guest_companions_v1(uuid) (original ab34f947cec8caa410540216fd3b39f1, new f1dac1d94870fb2575343b796fb94485). The only change is the gate: any staff_access_profiles row for auth.uid() with disabled_at null, instead of role owner or admin. Output shape {"companions":[{name: staff_redact_v1(name), has_photo}]}, attributes (sql, stable, security definer, search_path empty) and grants (revoked from public, anon, authenticated, service_role; postgres only) are unchanged. No ID photo path, phone or e-mail leaves the function. Its only caller is staff_home_v1, which is NOT replaced (live md5 b85530233f55696b136e4a49d1ed255c must be the same after the release): current_guest and next_guest gain the key companions for every active staff role.
backup.notes: Roll the staff app back before the SQL. Restamp restore_point and verified_at with a fresh backup at apply time (the checker refuses one older than an hour).

forward_verification.name: md5_staff_guest_companions_v1
forward_verification.query: select md5(replace(prosrc, chr(13), '')) = 'f1dac1d94870fb2575343b796fb94485' from pg_proc where oid = 'public.staff_guest_companions_v1(uuid)'::regprocedure

forward_verification.name: staff_guest_companions_v1_attributes_unchanged
forward_verification.query: select prosecdef and provolatile = 's' and proconfig = array['search_path=""'] and prorettype = 'jsonb'::regtype from pg_proc where oid = 'public.staff_guest_companions_v1(uuid)'::regprocedure

forward_verification.name: staff_guest_companions_v1_postgres_only
forward_verification.query: select not has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.staff_guest_companions_v1(uuid)'::regprocedure, 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.staff_guest_companions_v1(uuid)'::regprocedure, 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('service_role', 'public.staff_guest_companions_v1(uuid)'::regprocedure, 'execute')

forward_verification.name: gate_has_no_role_list
forward_verification.query: select prosrc !~ 'owner' and prosrc !~ 'admin' and prosrc ~ 'disabled_at is null' from pg_proc where oid = 'public.staff_guest_companions_v1(uuid)'::regprocedure

forward_verification.name: md5_staff_home_v1_unchanged
forward_verification.query: select md5(replace(prosrc, chr(13), '')) = 'b85530233f55696b136e4a49d1ed255c' from pg_proc where oid = 'public.staff_home_v1(uuid)'::regprocedure

rollback.safe_until: Always: the rollback only puts the owner/admin-only body back; no data is written by this release.

steps.name: run_compensating_script
steps.action: apply supabase/rollbacks/20261129_s129_staying_companions.sql with run-sql-on-host.sh; staff_guest_companions_v1 must be back to md5 ab34f947cec8caa410540216fd3b39f1. Roll the staff app back first.

feature_flags.name: no_flag_the_app_follows_the_sql
feature_flags.required_state: None. The staff app works with the companions key absent (it shows the booker and typed names only) and uses it when present; an old build ignores it.

compatibility.evidence: Not rehearsed yet: no local Postgres in the SQL lane. The orchestrator rehearses on a restored production backup (migration, forward verification 5 of 5, pgTAP s129_staying_companions.sql 23/23 and s79_staff_home_companions.sql 20/20), then sets verified to true.

the live md5 of staff_home_v1 is not b85530233f55696b136e4a49d1ed255c before or after the release
